upsert.title: Investigational anticancer drug for canine mast cell tumor
upsert.contacts: Enrollment contact: 徐老师 (Teacher Xu); WeChat enrollment link/QR is provided on the official study page.
upsert.notes: Official 2026-08-18 recruitment notice. Pathology-confirmed canine mast cell tumor; tumor must be recurrent or unresected. Dogs must be over 1 year old and without terminal severe heart, liver, kidney failure or severe anemia. Investigational anticancer drug and scheduled tumor-related reassessments are provided free during the study. Site team performs final screening.

upsert.title: Personalized mRNA-LNP immunotherapy for canine malignant tumors
upsert.contacts: WeChat: petcura; project team matches eligible owners with a participating veterinarian/hospital.
upsert.notes: Official study page updated 2026-08-15. Exploratory multicenter IIT using each dog's fresh tumor plus paired adjacent normal tissue for >=50G RNA sequencing, neoantigen selection and a personalized mRNA-LNP immunotherapy product. Requires histologic or cytologic confirmation, age >=2 years, generally weight >=5 kg (smaller dogs may be individually assessed), fresh tumor and paired normal tissue obtainable at surgery, adequate performance status/labs, and successful LNP tolerance testing. Excludes T-cell lymphoma and brain tumors; also excludes recent chemotherapy/radiation/high-dose corticosteroids within 2 weeks, severe infection/autoimmune disease/immunodeficiency, pregnancy/lactation, and expected survival <6 months. Owners pay some sampling/freezing/sequencing costs; personalized mRNA design/manufacture is funded by PETcura.
